entries.title: Song of Solomon 8:1
segments: ¶O that thou [wert] as my brother, that sucked the breasts of my mother! [when] I should find thee without, I would kiss thee; yea, I should not be despised. {I should not...: Heb. they should not despise me}

words.text: thee; yea, I should not be despised
. {I should not...: Heb. they should not despise me}

entries.title: Song of Solomon 8:2
segments: I would lead thee, [and] bring thee into my mother's house, [who] would instruct me: I would cause thee to drink of spiced wine of the juice of my pomegranate.

words.text: me: I would cause thee to drink

entries.title: Song of Solomon 8:3
segments: His left hand [should be] under my head, and his right hand should embrace me.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 8:4
segments: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, that ye stir not up, nor awake [my] love, until he please. {that...: Heb. why should ye stir up, or, why, etc}

words.text: . {that...: Heb. why should ye stir up, or, why, etc}

entries.title: Song of Solomon 8:5
segments: ¶Who [is] this that cometh up from the wilderness, leaning upon her beloved? I raised thee up under the apple tree: there thy mother brought thee forth: there she brought thee forth [that] bare thee.

words.text: thee up under the apple tree

entries.title: Song of Solomon 8:6
segments: Set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm: for love [is] strong as death; jealousy [is] cruel as the grave: the coals thereof [are] coals of fire, [which hath a] most vehement flame. {cruel: Heb. hard}

entries.title: Song of Solomon 8:7
segments: Many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it: if [a] man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would utterly be contemned.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 8:8
segments: ¶We have a little sister, and she hath no breasts: what shall we do for our sister in the day when she shall be spoken for?

words.text: when she shall be spoken for

entries.title: Song of Solomon 8:9
segments: If she [be] a wall, we will build upon her a palace of silver: and if she [be] a door, we will inclose her with boards of cedar.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 8:10
segments: I [am] a wall, and my breasts like towers: then was I in his eyes as one that found favour. {favour: Heb. peace}

words.text: : then was I in his eyes

entries.title: Song of Solomon 8:11
segments: Solomon had a vineyard at Baalhamon; he let out the vineyard unto keepers; every one for the fruit thereof was to bring a thousand [pieces] of silver.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 8:12
segments: My vineyard, which [is] mine, [is] before me: thou, O Solomon, [must have] a thousand, and those that keep the fruit thereof two hundred.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 8:13
segments: ¶Thou that dwellest in the gardens, the companions hearken to thy voice: cause me to hear [it].

entries.title: Song of Solomon 8:14
segments: Make haste, my beloved, and be thou like to a roe or to a young hart upon the mountains of spices. {Make...: Heb. Flee away}
